title: Object Storage: capacity entitlement — unused shared capacity
content:
For Object Storage capacity entitlement, subtract previously consumed included quantity on completed storage service records for that exact source and period from the shared capacity ceiling. Floor the residual shared capacity at zero. A clear storage official payment restriction state permits the residual shared capacity; a restricted official payment restriction state permits zero.

## Basis Q&A

What determines capacity entitlement in this situation? Subtract previously consumed included quantity on completed storage service records for that exact source and period from the shared capacity ceiling. Floor the residual shared capacity at zero. A clear storage official payment restriction state permits the residual shared capacity; a restricted official payment restriction state permits zero.
